response.what_it_is: A disassembled two-crank manual ICU bed in its packaging box
hidden_risks: Missing bolts, nuts, or small assembly hardware
Defects or scratches on metal parts hidden inside packaging
Smoothness and full functionality of the two crank mechanisms once assembled
Presence of all required parts (headboard, footboard, side rails, casters)
response.failure_mode: Mistaking a brand new boxed hospital bed for a used second-hand item, or vice versa due to it being disassembled.
